from collections import deque
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=0 or seen[i][j]: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft(); c.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and g[nx][ny]==0 and not seen[nx][ny]:
                        seen[nx][ny]=True; q.append((nx,ny))
            bottom = any(x==h-1 for x,y in c)
            right = any(y==w-1 for x,y in c)
            if right and not bottom: v=8
            elif bottom and not right: v=7
            else: v=None
            if v is None: continue
            for x,y in c: o[x][y]=v
    return o
